_meta.description: Machine-readable UCBA 2026 audit checklist — 145 verifiable rules. Used by compliance validators, CI checks, and audit agents.

rules.name: DOM Reset After 30 Days
rules.requirement: DOM resets to zero after 30 consecutive days in Withdrawn or Cancelled status
rules.verifyDescription: Check DOM_RESET_DAYS constant equals 30 and shouldResetDom() checks Withdrawn/Cancelled duration

rules.name: DOM Starts at RLS Transmission
rules.requirement: DOM starts when listing is transmitted to RLS, NOT listing contract date
rules.verifyDescription: Check DOM start uses status transition timestamp (approximates RLS transmission) and NOT listing_contract_date

rules.name: DOM Resets on Close
rules.requirement: DOM resets on sold (closed) or rented (closed)
rules.verifyDescription: Check Sold/Rented transitions freeze DOM at final value

rules.name: Coming Soon / Participant Only No DOM
rules.requirement: Coming Soon and Participant Only do NOT accrue DOM
rules.verifyDescription: Check ComingSoon excluded from accruing statuses AND Participant Only in suppressing permissions

rules.name: No DOM Circumvention
rules.requirement: Cannot circumvent DOM by re-naming or re-listing
rules.verifyDescription: Check cumulative DOM preserves history. Verify if re-listing detection by address exists.

rules.name: Protected Period — 6 Names
rules.requirement: Within 7 business days after listing expiration, Exclusive Broker delivers up to 6 names to Owner
rules.verifyDescription: ProtectedPeriod + ProtectedBuyer models, 5 API routes, CRM UI tab, cron notifications at 30d/7d/expiration, 7 biz day deadline enforcement.

rules.name: Protected Period — 90 Days
rules.requirement: If contract/lease executed within 90 days with one of the 6 names, Exclusive Broker entitled to compensation
rules.verifyDescription: 90-day window tracked via protection_ends_at. Convert endpoint marks deal_executed + period status=converted. Cron expires active periods after 90 days.

rules.name: Owner Must Notify New Broker
rules.requirement: Owner must notify any New Exclusive Broker of the protected period provision
rules.verifyDescription: Broker notified via listing_expiration notifications on expiration + missed deadline. CRM detail modal shows period info. Internal audit document — notice not sent to RLS.

rules.name: Exclusive Only
rules.requirement: RLS only accepts Exclusive Listings. No Open, FSBO, or Ours Alone.
rules.verifyDescription: Check ListingAgreement enum whitelist contains only exclusive types AND enforcement gate rejects others

rules.name: Simultaneous Distribution
rules.requirement: Must disseminate to RLS simultaneously with ANY public dissemination or first showing
rules.verifyDescription: Check if listings auto-submit to RLS on publish or require manual transition from Draft

rules.name: Owner Opt-Out Form Required
rules.requirement: Requires signed Owner Opt-Out Form (Exhibit B) within 48 hours
rules.verifyDescription: Check form has file upload field for Exhibit B with 48-hour warning text

rules.name: Owner Opt-Out No Public
rules.requirement: Opt-Out listings: NO public dissemination whatsoever
rules.verifyDescription: Check triple-layer block: enforcement gate + Trestle mapper + DB filter

rules.name: No Agent Info in Description
rules.requirement: No agent name, contact info, or URL in property description, photos, comments, or internet remarks
rules.verifyDescription: Check scanner blocks phone numbers, emails, URLs, and promotional phrases in PublicRemarks

rules.name: No Off-Market Language
rules.requirement: Cannot describe or promote any Exclusive Listing as Off-Market
rules.verifyDescription: Check 5 off-market patterns are blocked server-side

rules.name: No Compensation in Description
rules.requirement: No broker fees, closing costs, or compensation info in descriptions or comments
rules.verifyDescription: Check 5 compensation patterns are blocked server-side

rules.name: Closing Price Within 24hrs
rules.requirement: Must provide Closing Price within 24hrs of closing
rules.verifyDescription: Check if ClosePrice is REQUIRED when transitioning to Sold/Rented status

rules.name: Closed Listings Removed 24hrs
rules.requirement: Closed listings must be removed or marked closed on broker website within 24hrs
rules.verifyDescription: Check cron job sets idx_display_yn=false for closed >24h AND Trestle mapper blocks at query time

rules.name: Auction Listing Requirements
rules.requirement: Must include: minimum bid, date/time/location, registration, inspection, buyer's premium
rules.verifyDescription: Check for auction-specific fields in sale form. If zero matches, FAIL.

rules.name: Commission Negotiability
rules.requirement: Must disclose: Broker commissions are not set by law and are fully negotiable
rules.verifyDescription: Check disclosure checkbox on CRM forms AND disclosure text on public pages

rules.name: Fair Housing Language
rules.requirement: All descriptions must comply with FHA, NY State HRL, NYC HRL Title 8
rules.verifyDescription: Check scanner covers Federal FHA (7), NY HRL (4), NYC HRL Title 8 (6) protected classes. Must find 17+ patterns.

rules.name: Sales Only
rules.requirement: Coming Soon NOT allowed for rentals or new developments
rules.verifyDescription: Check enforcement gate blocks Coming Soon for rent and new development

rules.name: Maximum 14 Calendar Days
rules.requirement: From RLS submission to expiration
rules.verifyDescription: Check 14-day max enforcement as BLOCKER

rules.name: No Showings
rules.requirement: No showings under any circumstances during Coming Soon
rules.verifyDescription: Check showing POST returns 422 for ComingSoon listings

rules.name: Display Badge Required
rules.requirement: Must display: Coming Soon. No Showings or Open House until [Start Showing Date]
rules.verifyDescription: Check badge text matches REBNY requirement exactly on search cards AND detail page

rules.name: One-Time Use Per Address
rules.requirement: One-time per address/owner unless off-market 60+ days
rules.verifyDescription: Check for DB query that looks up previous Coming Soon listings by address via _wasComingSoon flag

rules.name: Showing Start Date Immutable
rules.requirement: ActivationDate cannot be changed once set
rules.verifyDescription: Check if update path blocks changes to ActivationDate when previously set

rules.name: Buyer Rep Agreement Before Showing
rules.requirement: Co-Broker must have executed Buyer Representation Agreement before any showing
rules.verifyDescription: Check if showing POST verifies buyer rep agreement exists before allowing creation

rules.name: No Unauthorized Use
rules.requirement: Listing data may not be disclosed/sold/leased/exploited or provided to third parties
rules.verifyDescription: Check bot blocking, rate limiting, auth on data endpoints

rules.name: IDX/VOW Attribution Required
rules.requirement: Must include Listing Courtesy of [Broker] in reasonably prominent location
rules.verifyDescription: Check attribution text appears on listing detail page AND search cards

rules.name: Data Accuracy Required
rules.requirement: Incomplete mandatory items or incorrect data = violation
rules.verifyDescription: Check enforcement gate validates all 48 mandatory + 51 conditional fields

rules.name: No Compensation on RLS
rules.requirement: RLS does NOT collect or display any offers of compensation
rules.verifyDescription: Check compensation fields stripped at all DTO tiers AND rejected on write path

rules.name: Fully Negotiable
rules.requirement: Must disclose commissions are fully negotiable
rules.verifyDescription: Check disclosure text appears on listing pages, search results, and calculator

rules.name: Attribution Required
rules.requirement: Every listing must show Listing Courtesy of [Broker Name]
rules.verifyDescription: Check attribution on detail page, search cards, and all listing display surfaces

rules.name: Respect Owner Opt-Outs
rules.requirement: Owner Opt-Out listings must NEVER appear publicly
rules.verifyDescription: Check owner opt-out filtering at ALL layers: Trestle gate, DB query, portal DTO, detail page

rules.name: Respect Participant Only
rules.requirement: Participant Only listings: authorized Participant view only, NOT public
rules.verifyDescription: Check participant-only filtering at Trestle gate, DB query, and portal DTO

rules.name: Coming Soon Display Badge
rules.requirement: Must display: Coming Soon. No Showings or Open House until [Start Showing Date]
rules.verifyDescription: Check ALL listing display surfaces show full required text including LiveListingsWidget

rules.name: Protect Confidential Fields
rules.requirement: InternetAddressDisplayYN=False → hide address. ExpirationDate → never display.
rules.verifyDescription: Check address suppression replaces with 'Address Undisclosed' and ExpirationDate stripped

rules.name: No Compensation Displayed
rules.requirement: No commission/fee fields on any listing display
rules.verifyDescription: Check all compensation fields in REMOVED_FIELDS and no amounts in frontend components

rules.name: Owner Opt-Out
rules.requirement: ALL fields blocked from ALL channels when owner opts out
rules.verifyDescription: Check owner_opt_out filtering at ALL 9 enforcement points

rules.name: Participant Only
rules.requirement: All fields to RLS only. No IDX, VOW, Syndication, websites.
rules.verifyDescription: Check participant_only filtering at all entry points

rules.name: IDX Display
rules.requirement: IDXEntireListingDisplayYN=False → excluded from IDX websites
rules.verifyDescription: Check idx_display_yn filtering at Trestle gate, DB queries, and DTO

rules.name: Syndication
rules.requirement: SyndicateYN=False → excluded from syndication portals
rules.verifyDescription: Check SyndicateYN enforcement on write path. Correctly scoped to 3rd-party portals.

rules.name: Coming Soon
rules.requirement: Badge required, showings restricted, 14-day max
rules.verifyDescription: Check Coming Soon badge display + showing block + 14-day enforcement

rules.name: Closed Status
rules.requirement: Must remove/mark closed within 24hrs
rules.verifyDescription: Check cron + Trestle gate enforce 24hr removal

rules.name: NumberOfShares (Co-op)
rules.requirement: Required for co-op/condop listings
rules.verifyDescription: Check field exists WITHOUT data-rls-ignore AND is mapped in payload builder to NumberOfShares

rules.name: TaxMonthlyAmount (Condo)
rules.requirement: Required for condo listings
rules.verifyDescription: Check field exists in sale form. TaxAnnualAmount is NOT the same field.
